headline: Elon Musk Donates Millions to Pro-Data Centre Midterm Candidates in Texas
summary: Elon Musk donated millions to pro-data center candidates in Texas, which flipped to the Democrats in the midterm elections.
why: Political donations by high-profile technology executives highlight corporate lobbying and political engagement regarding data infrastructure development.
